title.zh: 巨螯肢虫属来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Megachelicerax to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开巨螯肢虫属，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Olenoides time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的奥莱诺虫属时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 三叶虫与螯肢类证据比较

description.en: Compare Olenoides and Megachelicerax through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较奥莱诺虫属与巨螯肢虫属；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a rounded 514.5 Ma Tatelt Formation map window for ash-entombed Protolenus specimens and inspect the microtomographic reconstruction of ventral limbs, labrum, mouth and digestive tissues tied to the cited study.
description.zh: 在取整为 5.145 亿年前的 Tatelt 组地图窗口中打开被火山灰包埋的 Protolenus 标本，检查与引文研究相连的腹侧肢、唇基、口部和消化组织微型断层扫描重建。

limitations: The rounded 514.5 Ma age is a Tatelt Formation specimen-envelope midpoint (approximately 515–514 Ma), not a direct date on a specimen or a global trilobite FAD/LAD.
The named Protolenus and Gigoutella anatomy is directly imaged; ventral homology, feeding mechanics and any phylogenetic placement remain reconstruction or model interpretations, not direct ancestry.
Map context is a sampled locality window and does not assert complete distribution, exact fossil-to-map co-registration or observed behaviour.

title.zh: Šárka组 Bohemolichas肠内容物出现窗口

description.en: Open a rounded 464.5 Ma Šárka Formation map window for Prague Basin inventory specimen 8 of Bohemolichas incola and inspect its synchrotron gut-content mapping and bounded palaeophysiological interpretation.
description.zh: 在取整为 4.645 亿年前的 Šárka 组地图窗口中打开布拉格盆地 Bohemolichas incola 目录标本 8，检查同步辐射肠内容物成像及其有边界的古生理解释。

limitations: The rounded 464.5 Ma age is the Šárka Formation specimen-envelope midpoint (approximately 466–463 Ma), not an exact date for inventory specimen 8 or a global genus range.
Ostracod, hyolith and stylophoran remains are direct fossil gut content; feeding rate, selectivity, chemistry and habitual diet remain one-meal inferences or model interpretations.
The map shows a sampled Prague Basin locality context and does not establish complete distribution, exact co-location or observed feeding behaviour.

description.en: Open a rounded 446.5 Ma Beecher’s Trilobite Bed map window for Triarthrus eatoni and inspect the ESEM and micro-CT filament geometry and body-wall attachment used in the respiratory-branch comparison.
description.zh: 在取整为 4.465 亿年前的 Beecher 三叶虫层地图窗口中打开 Triarthrus eatoni，检查用于呼吸支比较的环境扫描电镜与微型断层扫描丝状结构和体壁附着。

limitations: The rounded 446.5 Ma age is a broad Upper Ordovician Beecher’s Bed sample envelope (approximately 450–443 Ma), not a direct date for Triarthrus eatoni or a global range endpoint.
Filaments and attachment are preserved morphology; respiratory performance, flow and homology are comparative functional-model hypotheses rather than measured physiology or direct ancestry.
Map markers represent sampled New York locality context and do not imply complete distribution, exact specimen co-registration or observed behaviour.

title.zh: 澄江 Urokodia附肢模型窗口

description.en: Open a rounded 518.5 Ma Chengjiang Yu’anshan Member map window for Urokodia aequalis and inspect micro-CT pincer-like appendages, exite flaps and the seven-segmented head used in a stem-chelicerate model.
description.zh: 在取整为 5.185 亿年前的澄江玉案山段地图窗口中打开 Urokodia aequalis，检查用于螯肢干群模型的微型断层扫描钳状附肢、外叶瓣和七节头部。

limitations: The rounded 518.5 Ma age is the Chengjiang Urokodia sample envelope (approximately 519–518 Ma), not a direct date, crown-chelicerate origin or global first appearance.

Appendages and segments are directly reconstructed from the cited material; chelicera and book-gill homology and upper stem placement depend on character scoring and phylogenetic models, not a direct ancestor sequence.
The map is a sampled Chengjiang locality context and does not assert complete distribution, exact fossil-to-map co-registration or observed feeding or locomotor behaviour.

title.zh: 布尔吉斯页岩 Mollisonia神经解剖窗口

description.en: Open a rounded 506.55 Ma Burgess Shale map window for Mollisonia symmetrica specimens MCZ 1811 and USNM 305093 and inspect elemental mapping of optic nerves, a possible cephalic synganglion and the segmental nerve cord.
description.zh: 在取整为 5.0655 亿年前的布尔吉斯页岩地图窗口中打开 Mollisonia symmetrica 标本 MCZ 1811 与 USNM 305093，检查视神经、可能的头部神经节和分节腹神经索的元素成像。

limitations: The rounded 506.55 Ma age is the cited Burgess Shale sample-envelope midpoint (approximately 508.1–505 Ma), not a direct date for either specimen or a global genus duration.

Elemental and positional signals support the reported neural-tissue interpretation; incomplete preservation, appendicular conflict and topology-model choice leave ancestral organization and stem placement contested.
Map context is a sampled Canadian locality window and does not establish complete distribution, exact co-registration, direct ancestry or observed behaviour.

title.zh: 惠勒组 Megachelicerax螯肢出现窗口

description.en: Open a rounded 502.5 Ma Wheeler Formation map window for Megachelicerax cousteaui holotype KUMIP 314091a,b and inspect its three-segmented chelicerae, prosomal limbs and lamellate opisthosomal appendages in the cited morphology model.
description.zh: 在取整为 5.025 亿年前的惠勒组地图窗口中打开 Megachelicerax cousteaui 正模 KUMIP 314091a、b，检查引文形态模型中的三节螯肢、前体肢和具片状结构的腹部附肢。

limitations: The rounded 502.5 Ma age is the Wheeler Formation holotype-envelope midpoint (approximately 504.5–500.5 Ma), not a direct radiometric date or global FAD.

The part and counterpart preserve the named anatomy; predation, functional performance and the bridging stem-chelicerate position remain morphology, matrix and model interpretations, not direct ancestry or observed behaviour.
Map context is a sampled Utah locality window and does not establish complete distribution or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

description.en: Open the Darriwilian 467.3–458.4 Ma Winneshiek Lagerstätte window near Decorah, Iowa, for the named megalograptid eurypterid Pentecopterus decorahensis (including holotype SUI 139941 and more than 150 cuticular specimens) and inspect its morphology-matrix evidence for early eurypterid disparity.
description.zh: 打开爱荷华州迪科拉附近Winneshiek化石库的达瑞威尔期 4.673–4.584 亿年前窗口，检查具名巨翼鲎类海蝎 Pentecopterus decorahensis（包括正模 SUI 139941 及150余件角质层标本）及其早期海蝎形态差异矩阵证据。

limitations: The 467.3–458.4 Ma interval is the regional Darriwilian absolute-timescale envelope for the Winneshiek Shale, not a direct date on each specimen or a global eurypterid FAD/LAD.

The named species, preserved cuticle and appendage morphology are direct specimen evidence; megalograptid placement, explosive radiation and any Cambrian ghost range are matrix or historical inferences, not direct ancestry.

PBDB modern and reconstructed palaeocoordinates represent a bounded locality sample near Decorah and are separate coordinate models; they do not establish complete distribution, exact specimen co-registration or a global origin.

title.zh: Willwerath组 Jaekelopterus rhenaniae巨型螯肢窗口

description.en: Open the rounded 411–407 Ma Early Devonian Willwerath Lagerstätte window in the Rhenish Slate Mountains for the Jaekelopterus rhenaniae chelicera, with a 36.4 cm preserved fixed ramus and an estimated 45.5 cm if complete, and inspect the cited allometric body-size reconstruction.
description.zh: 打开莱茵板岩山早泥盆世 4.11–4.07 亿年前 Willwerath化石库窗口，检查 Jaekelopterus rhenaniae 螯肢：固定支保存长度36.4厘米，完整长度估算45.5厘米；并查看引文中的异速生长体长重建。

limitations: The 411–407 Ma interval is a broad Willwerath locality envelope, not a direct radiometric date for the claw or a global Jaekelopterus FAD/LAD.

The chelicera includes a 36.4 cm preserved fixed ramus (estimated 45.5 cm if complete) and a complete 28.8 cm free ramus; the approximately 2.5 m body length is an allometric estimate based on pterygotid proportions and claw-scaling assumptions, not a direct whole-body measurement, while predation and swimming performance are ecological models.

Map markers use sampled Willwerath coordinates with separate palaeogeographic reconstruction and collection bias; they do not establish complete distribution, exact fossil-to-map co-registration or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 沃基肖 Parioscorpio venator内部解剖窗口

description.en: Open the 437.5–436.5 Ma conodont-bounded Brandon Bridge Formation window at the Waukesha Lagerstätte for Parioscorpio venator holotype UWGM 2162 and paratype UWGM 2163; read Wendruff et al. (2020)'s historical scorpion-terrestrialization interpretation alongside Anderson et al. (2021)'s redescription rejecting scorpion affinity and leaving exact arthropod relationships unresolved.
description.zh: 打开沃基肖化石库 Brandon Bridge组经牙形刺限定的 4.375–4.365 亿年前窗口，检查 Parioscorpio venator 正模 UWGM 2162 与副模 UWGM 2163；对照 Wendruff 等（2020）的历史蝎类陆生化解释，以及 Anderson 等（2021）否定蝎类归属并认为确切节肢动物亲缘未定的重新描述。

limitations: The 437.5–436.5 Ma age is a conodont-bounded depositional interval, not a direct date on either specimen or a global scorpion FAD.

The named specimens and preserved medial structures are direct observations; Wendruff et al. (2020)'s scorpion and book-lung interpretation is historical, while Anderson et al. (2021) rejected scorpion affinity and left exact arthropod placement unresolved; pulmonary-cardiovascular homology and terrestrial physiology are therefore not established.

PBDB coordinates identify the sampled Waukesha locality and its separate palaeogeographic model; transport and preservation bias prevent claims of complete distribution, exact fossil-to-map co-registration or direct ancestry.

description.en: Use the 500 Ma map as generic taxon/age context and read the linked evidence for larval Cambropycnogon from Swedish Upper Cambrian Orsten, originally proposed as an early sea-spider or chelicerate record.
description.zh: 以 500 Ma 地图作为一般类群/时间背景，阅读关联证据中瑞典上寒武统 Orsten 的 Cambropycnogon 幼体材料及其最初被提出的海蜘蛛或螯肢类归属。

limitations: The 500 Ma selector is a rounded Upper Cambrian Orsten context, not a direct date for each larval specimen or a secure crown-Pycnogonida FAD; a later fossil synthesis retains the assignment as possible rather than certain.

Larval morphology and the original systematic proposal are observations and taxonomic interpretation, while chelicerate or pycnogonid placement remains contested; the scene does not establish a direct ancestor or uninterrupted lineage.

The route opens generic taxon/period map context; it has no study-locality or specimen selector. Read the linked evidence dossier for the cited material. Available markers are separate occurrence records and do not locate or guarantee those study samples.

description.en: Use the rounded 480 Ma total-group envelope as navigation context and read the linked fossil-and-living xiphosuran morphology matrix and its test of traditional synziphosurine groupings.
description.zh: 以取整的 480 Ma 总群包络作为导航背景，阅读关联的剑尾类化石与现生形态矩阵，以及对传统合剑尾类分组的检验。

limitations: The 480 Ma display is the older edge of a broad Xiphosura navigation envelope, not a direct date for a single specimen or a global xiphosuran FAD/LAD.

The matrix can place traditional synziphosurines on several euchelicerate stems, but topology is sensitive to coding, missing anatomy and taxon sampling; it is a classification model, not a direct ancestor sequence or habitat history.

The route opens generic taxon/period map context; it has no study-locality or specimen selector. Read the linked evidence dossier for the cited material. Available markers are separate occurrence records and do not locate or guarantee those study samples.

title.zh: 早泥盆世螨类化石记录窗口

description.en: Use the rounded 410 Ma Early Devonian anchor as map context and read the linked review of early mite records and its exclusion of unsupported older assignments.
description.zh: 以取整的 410 Ma 早泥盆世锚点作为地图背景，阅读关联的早期螨类化石记录综述及其对缺乏支持的更早归属的排除。

limitations: The 410 Ma selector follows a systematic review of more than 260 mite fossils and is a conservative oldest-reviewed-record anchor, not a direct date for every specimen or a consensus Acari crown age.

The fossil review documents occurrence and taxonomic screening; topology, divergence time and living-group relationships are not supplied by this scene, and the route does not claim a direct ancestor or global FAD/LAD.

The route opens generic taxon/period map context; it has no study-locality or specimen selector. Read the linked evidence dossier for the cited material. Available markers are separate occurrence records and do not locate or guarantee those study samples.
